_comment: Featured engineering work by Pathos Kratos. Selected to represent AI systems, backend architecture, APIs, computer vision, IoT, and production-oriented development.

projects.description: Legal-tech platform connecting clients and advocates with lawyer profiles, scheduling, messaging, authentication, and backend services built around Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Supabase.
Modular AI agent service with agents, data providers, decision engines, ML models, orchestration, streaming, and task execution for building intelligent backend workflows.
Crypto API Gateway with a structured Python backend architecture for exposing and managing cryptocurrency-related services through modular API and core layers.
Python backend platform for application tooling, documentation services, PDF utilities, and extensible API workflows, deployed as a production web service.
Real-time Python photobooth system with image processing, background removal, filters, effects, REST APIs, and WebSocket communication for interactive photo workflows.
Connected IoT system built around ESP32 with Bluetooth provisioning, Wi-Fi configuration, WebSocket communication, remote commands, and server-driven device interaction.
